title: Products
description: Healing water, protection and wealth sprays, crystals, kits, and ritual tools from Priya in Dehradun. Charged for the person who asked.

hero.title:
She charges it.
You take it home.
hero.body: Healing water, a spray, a crystal, a kit, or the tools for a ritual. Write her the issue. She charges the piece for you, and tells you how to use it.
hero.imageAlt: Stones set out for a healing piece

intro.title:
The water and the sprays first.
Then the pieces you already know.

items.name: Healing Water
items.summary: A sanctified elixir, chanted over every 5ml in an auspicious hour, and always made for one person. You take it as medicine — Happy, Healthy, and Healed.
items.imageAlt: A labelled dropper bottle of healing water in a bowl among flowers
points: Twelve drops in 500ml, twice a day — or twenty-one drops in a litre, sipped through the day
Enchanted for the person who asked

items.name: Protection spray
items.summary: The same method — mantra, auspicious hour, made for you. A spray to seal the aura against the evil eye, entities, and what will not settle. Keep using it. The change is not one day.
items.imageAlt: A labelled bottle of protection spray in the grass beside flowers
points: Spray seven or eight inches above the head, at the shoulders, and at the feet
For the aura — clarity, stability, and what sits too heavy

items.name: Wealth spray
items.summary: Chanted the same way, for one person, to call wealth and success. It is a spray for the body — not to drink. No chemicals.
items.imageAlt: A labelled bottle of wealth spray standing in the grass among flowers
points: Use on the body. Do not consume
How long the bottle lasts depends on how often you spray. Often more than a month

items.name: Crystals
items.summary: A stone for the issue you are in — elemental correction, not a pretty object from a tray. She names it, then charges it, then it leaves.
items.imageAlt: A stone being named and charged for the issue

items.name: Healing kits
items.summary: A small set of tools for the method you will actually use at home. She will say what is in it, why, and what to do first.
items.imageAlt: A healing kit packed for home use

items.name: Ritual casting tools
items.summary: What a candle working needs. She will say which tools, how they are held, and what she needs from you before you begin.
items.imageAlt: Tools laid out for a candle working

items.title: A plain name
items.body: Water, spray, crystal, kit, or tool. Something you can ask for again.

items.title: A reason
items.body: One job — a correction, a method, or a ritual. Not a mixed bag.

items.title: A charge
items.body: Done for the person who asked. Nothing leaves as a generic object.

items.title: A way to ask
items.body: Write the situation. The product name can wait.

faq.title: About the pieces
faq.intro: What people ask before they take something home.

items.a: No. Only Healing Water is to drink. Protection spray and Wealth spray go on the body.

items.q: How do I take the Healing Water?
items.a: Twelve drops in 500ml, twice a day. Or twenty-one drops in a litre, sipped through the day. Treat it as medicine.

items.q: Do I pick the crystal myself?
items.a: No. Tell her the issue. She will say which water, spray, stone, kit, or tool belongs with it. If you already have a name in mind, write that too.

items.q: Are these sitting on a shelf?
items.a: No. The piece is chosen after she hears you, then charged before it leaves. That is why a short note comes first.

items.q: Can I use a kit without a sitting?
items.a: Sometimes. She will say if the kit is enough on its own, or if a sitting should come first.

items.q: Can you send it if I am not in Dehradun?
items.a: Yes, once she has named the piece. Say where you are when you write.

items.q: How do I ask for one?
items.a: WhatsApp {phone}, email {email}, or use the contact page. Name the issue. The product name can wait.

contact.title:
Ask for the piece,
not the name.

cards.title: Write what the issue is
cards.body: Healing water, a spray, a crystal, a kit, or a ritual tool. Leave your name and a number. She will say which piece fits.

cards.title: Prefer WhatsApp?
cards.body: Send the situation in a few lines. She will tell you what to take home.

closing.title: Tell Priya what the piece is for.
closing.body: The right water, spray, crystal, or kit depends on the issue. A short note is the way to begin.
